contract: An artwork approved for a liturgical event can be reused at every other matching event across Rosary, Stations, chaplets, novenas, and Prayer; missing checkbox does not mean rejection.
Preserve explicit not_relevant, reject, scope-only and final-cover locks; never reinterpret different scenes as identical.
An approved work may have many route edges; same work identity must stay exact, never substitute a different painting with the same artist/subject.
Scene matches are editorial reuse, not photograph/rights approval, and never proof of live reader card parity.
An exact-scene gap can temporarily inherit a contextual artwork only as an explicitly marked, unpublished editorial fallback.
Do not invent new approvals or violate the user's €0 and frame-free/no-low-quality-photo requirements.
